UI UX Design Fundamentals

UI UX Design Fundamentals

Expert-level UI/UX designs with Figma and Photoshop, journey from wireframe to prototype.

Overview

In this course, you will explore the core principles of design, including layout, color theory, typography, and visual hierarchy. You will also dive deep into UX concepts such as user research, user journeys, and persona creation to better understand user behavior and needs. By combining creativity with problem-solving techniques, you’ll learn how to design products that are both visually appealing and highly functional.

You will gain hands-on experience with industry-standard tools like Figma, where you’ll create wireframes, prototypes, and real-world design projects. The course also covers usability testing, helping you evaluate your designs and make improvements based on user feedback.
